text: Visitors have noted significant crowding issues, with some describing difficulty moving through exhibits and maintaining personal space, despite the use of timed tickets. Several reviews pointed out confusion and frustration around the timed entry system, including a lack of clear signage or information at nearby visitor centers and on the website. Concerns were raised about construction quality, including issues with wood paneling and cracking in rammed earth walls. Some visitors criticized the gift shop for not featuring local artists and expressed dissatisfaction with the use of AI-generated content in exhibits. Positive comments focused on the building’s architecture and views, but these were tempered by the other concerns.
